_comment: Canonical expected verdicts for the ARD reference lint. Any re-implementation of the lint must reproduce these. Runner: python3 run.py

version_anchor._comment: version-number anchor rule (CATALOGS §3 item 2), by fixture line. 'suppressed' lines must not fire version-number: the source-direct attestation tier, and cited lines whose resolved or reduced-substrate attestation contains the matched token. 'flagged' lines must fire: uncited; cited attestation lacks the token (incl. a prefix such as 3.1 vs 3.12, or a different 'version N'); a non-anchor citation status (intra-program, acquisition-candidate); one unanchored token among anchored ones. Dotted 'version N.M' is keyed on the whole dotted token: 'version 3.9' is not anchored by an attestation that only contains 'Version 3'.
